Subject: SOC 2 Type II, Trust Portal Access and Bridge Letter - Acme Health

Hi John / security team -

Thanks again for the call this morning - great discussion on how Redwood Inference can help Acme Health reduce inference costs while meeting latency and compliance needs. Per our discovery, your security team will need the latest SOC 2 Type II report, a bridge letter if the report falls outside your required window, and access to our trust portal so you can download artifacts directly.

Next steps I have noted:
- Can you share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or confirm when it will be available)?
- If the report is from 2025 (or older), will you accept a bridge letter?
- Please invite marissa@redwood.com and aditya@redwood.com to your trust portal (or provide a secure upload link).
- If you prefer, we can also complete your vendor security questionnaire - please send the questionnaire link.

Our compliance team is targeting a 5 business day turnaround for review once we have the artifacts. If you need a doc showing current coverage for procurement, we can provide a short bridge letter from our auditor.

Appreciate the help - happy to jump on a quick follow-up call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the recap and for the clear asks. Quick answers:

- Procurement typically accepts a bridge letter for coverage gaps; our security lead will prepare that.

I'll check with procurement on any additional forms they need and follow up if anything else is required.
